entities.summary: Richard Dafydd Vivian Llewellyn Lloyd, known by his pen name Richard Llewellyn, was an English novelist of Welsh descent, who is best remembered for his 1939 novel How Green Was My Valley, which chronicles life in a coal mining village in the South Wales Valleys.
